steps.en: Officer chooses multiple and opens the CSV upload page
steps.id: Officer memilih multiple lalu membuka halaman upload CSV
steps.why_en: The upload page and its route were removed.
steps.why_id: Halaman upload dan route-nya sudah dihapus.

steps.en: Officer uploads a CSV with numbers or emails, subjects and messages
steps.id: Officer upload CSV berisi nomor/email, subject, pesan
steps.why_en: No CSV upload for messages exists; only a generic file check.
steps.why_id: Tidak ada upload CSV pesan; hanya pengecekan file umum.

steps.en: The system reads and checks the CSV columns
steps.id: Sistem membaca dan memeriksa kolom CSV
steps.why_en: No code reads message columns from a CSV file.
steps.why_id: Tidak ada code yang membaca kolom pesan dari file CSV.

steps.en: The fields are filled in automatically from the file
steps.why_en: No auto-fill exists on the current code.
steps.why_id: Tidak ada pengisian otomatis di code saat ini.

steps.en: The populated rows are shown on screen
steps.id: Baris hasil isian ditampilkan di layar
steps.why_id: Tidak ada layar yang menampilkan pesan hasil upload.
